content_metadata.description: A tutorial video demonstrating the steps to install Android 9.0 Pie on Treble enabled devices using Project Treble.

qAndA.question: What app is used to verify if the phone supports Project Treble?
Which custom recovery is recommended in the video?

qAndA.answer: Mokee ROM. It is used as a base because it has built-in Project Treble support and supports most of the devices that support Project Treble.
qAndA.question: What is the base ROM used in the video? Why?

qAndA.answer: They are installed separately to fix potential issues with Google apps and camera functionality after the initial installation of Android Pie. This ensures the ROM becomes suitable for daily use.
qAndA.question: Why are Google Play Services and Camera APKs installed separately?

qAndA.answer: The video encourages viewers to leave a comment describing their issue so the creator can offer assistance.
qAndA.question: What does the video suggest doing if you encounter any issues during the procedure?
